vikram janakiraman.text: Around 30 years of experience across consulting leadership and pharmaceutical operations. He joins Cipla from Boston Consulting Group as Managing Director and Senior Partner, where he built BCG India's Pharma Operations and Automotive practices and led Operations and Industrial Goods practices.

prashant verma.text: Around 21 years of experience in the security domain. He has served as Bajaj Finance's Chief Information Security Officer since February 2024, joined the company as head of its Cyber Risk Unit, and previously architected security services and worked as a security auditor and consultant for domestic and international banks and insurers. He is a CISSP and co-author of security books.

sources.title: Bajaj Finance change in senior management filing, 19 October 2026

sunil kumar.text: Currently an Executive Director at ONGC and Asset Manager of its Mehsana Asset. His appointment as Chairman was approved for assumption of charge on or after 7 December 2026. Public reporting identifies him as a petroleum engineering graduate of the Indian School of Mines, with a postgraduate business-management qualification focused on marketing and finance.

sources.title: ONGC filing: Letter from Administrative Ministry regarding appointment of Chairman
Business Standard: Sunil Kumar appointed ONGC chairman

anup bagchi.text: Over three decades of experience across banking, capital markets, wealth management and insurance. Before joining HDFC Bank as MD & CEO, he served as MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance and as Executive Director of ICICI Bank from 2017 to 2023, overseeing retail, business and rural banking and wholesale banking. He holds a management degree from IIM Bangalore and an engineering degree from IIT Kanpur.

sources.title: HDFC Bank management team – Anup Bagchi

diwakar nath misra.text: A 2000-batch IAS officer of the Assam–Meghalaya cadre, serving as Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Power. NTPC identifies him as a Government Nominee Director. His public-sector career includes senior administrative roles across state and central government departments.

sources.title: NTPC Board of Directors – Shri Diwakar Nath Misra

girish paranjpe.text: Served as Co-CEO of Wipro’s IT Business from 2008 to 2011 and spent more than two decades at Wipro. He later served as Managing Director of Bloom Energy International and has been involved in technology-focused venture investing. He is a Commerce graduate and a member of the ICAI and ICWAI.
